changesets.name: finished-failed-answers.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": patch
---

### Fixed

- Close stale failed answers for done, released, deferred or dropped work with `close-finished-decisions`, recording why the decision closed and removing it from orchestrator status and watch reports. Failed answers for active work keep waiting on the orchestrator.

changesets.name: native-admin-jobs.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/admin": minor
"@shivaedev/effect-pg-boss": minor
---

### Added

- `@shivaedev/admin` provides a query-only Jobs page with explicitly registered queues, payload codecs, health, counts, paginated failed and dead-lettered jobs, and job lookup through the protected admin RPC group. Jobs failures remain declared and do not prevent other pages from serving requests.
- `@shivaedev/effect-pg-boss` job reads accept a queue's name and payload Schema without requiring its worker configuration.

changesets.name: native-client-origins.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
---

### Added

- Allow explicitly listed native origins through appHost RPC and auth routes with exact CORS responses and bearer-only cross-origin sessions. Native WebView fetch keeps incremental NDJSON delivery and cancellation while existing transport protections remain in place.
